description: ADCOS Node object: a cryptographically identified participant in the fabric. Required fields encode the frozen list of spec/architecture.md §6.1. Field structures that the architecture does not freeze (resource_state, trust_state) are open objects whose internal schemas are owned by later Work Items (WORK-008 resources, WORK-004 identity/trust).

administrative_domains.description: Administrative domain references the node belongs to.

capabilities.description: Capability statement references (adcos.capability instances; identifiers from the capability registry).

node_id.description: Stable NodeID; identity format is owned by the identity Work Item (WORK-004).

protocol_versions.description: Set of protocol versions the node speaks (WORK-003 owns the version line semantics).

resource_state.description: Node resource state; internal structure owned by the resource model Work Item (WORK-008).

roles.description: Additive, dynamic roles. A role is never itself an identity (architecture §4).

trust_state.description: Node trust/attestation state; internal structure owned by identity/trust Work Items.

title: ADCOS Node
